Getting the GitHub issues of a package

Source: R/package_evaluate.R
evaluate_bugs.Rd

evaluate_bugs() reads the BugReports field in the DESCRIPTION file of an installed package, and gets the issues of its GitHub repository.

Usage

evaluate_bugs(pkg)

Arguments

pkg

The name of an installed package.

Value

A data frame of the issues, as returned by githubr::get_issues().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
evaluate_bugs("manypkgs")
} # }
